snippet.title: Soulbound: Online — Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
A pixel MMORPG built by a small indie team with a big vision.
🔗 *Free Demo & Wishlist on Steam:* https://store.steampowered.com/app/4369490/Soulbound_Online/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=gameplay_trailer&utm_medium=video
Soulbound: Online is a pixel art multiplayer RPG where thousands of players explore a dangerous virtual world together. Combat is co-op bullet heaven and borrows feeling from modern roguelites. Build and decorate your own home and invite your guild, and as you unlock abilities mix and match 100+ relics to create your perfect spec. 

Wishlist now on Steam.

🔗 *Wishlist on Steam:* https://store.steampowered.com/app/4369490/Soulbound_Online/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=gameplay_trailer&utm_medium=video
🌐 *Official Site:* https://soulbound.game
🐦 *Twitter/X:* https://x.com/Soulbound
